title: [Improvement] Improve UX for Config Builder by only showing selected options
body:
The Config builder is starting to get very long with the growing pump/cgm support. Should we considering adding some sort of minimizing feature? That way all non-selected options can be automatically hidden, and only show the ones that you have selected, and add a button so you can expand the list to show all options. 

Thoughts or possibly other ideas how to improve Config Builder?
Illustration of how it could be done:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e77e5aa1-76ca-487d-ab90-97ae01e5522c)


How the long the list is actually today :)

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/81e1ea28-5812-4a19-9b4c-2b5d07a9819d)

comments.body: Much needed for sure! Thoughts on something like this I replaced the checkboxes with the eye icon

I like it :) 

So the list is auto-collapsed when opening Config Builder, and you can expand every section by clicking arrow button right?
Do you have a branch for this to be tested ? or just early stages trying to visualize it?

This is just a quick mockup in figma. It will behave similar to the preferences page - Users can see the headings once they open the config builder and choose which one they would like to expand. Initially, I was thinking of doing it like the android settings page. Instead of dropdowns, having separate pages open for each category. We need to update the preferences page as well - We can expand headings but not collapse them.
Great idea about improving preferences also, I was looking at how to remove the word "advanced" from every block but it seemed to origin from a read-only file so that kind of stopped me as of now ;)
